name: similar-chars
description:
The phrase with the letters that look alike in both alphabets (а a, В B, Н H, р p, с c, у y, х x…) in one alphabet.

The other letters stay.

to: the alphabet: "en" — «Москва» → «Mockвa»; "ru" — «CTO» → «СТО».

Example: semkit read --text "Москва" similar-chars en write -
-> Mockвa
Example: semkit read --text "CTO" similar-chars ru write -
-> СТО

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: TO
arguments.description: the alphabet: "en" — «Москва» → «Mockвa»; "ru" — «CTO» → «СТО». The same as --to TO.
